title: Research: exclude P112 3,4,6^8 with a weighted A6 cover
body:
## Summary

```text
P112 profile 3,4,6^8, code-intersection dimension >= 6
  -> seven weight-six endpoints, allowance 140
  -> mixed root/D7 branch >= 142
  -> weighted root-A6 branch >= 141
  -> one actual TWOSIDE (6,4) profile excluded
```

Adds only `research/p112-a6-weighted-cover/`, with the characteristic-zero proof, exact receipt, pinned sources, separate finite checks and replay instructions. This answers one part of the [C5 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156). [Canonical claim and its scope correction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000400).

The new lemma retains a binary six-flat and four-flat plus the orthogonal puncture frame, while relaxing the rank-three support to four arbitrary coordinates. The initial `2,4,6^8` candidate was discarded because #3162 already excludes it. The present profile needs twelve certified cuts and has no rank-four nonbasis anchor, so the pinned ten-cut and twelve-cut-anchor results do not close it by that route.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/#3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d` for TWOSIDE, Nick Petalas/#3176 at `1111a074414c4d2be8b4e230133d873432780814` for the retained support-72 alphabet and geometry, and the credited E8/P112 lineage in `SOURCES.json`, including #3164/#3175 and joaqcoo's model. Frame traversal is adapted from #3180. Canonical main remains `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6.

## Evidence

- Before, forty arbitrary deletions give only 137 incidences; retaining the frame and six-flat but allowing twelve arbitrary small coordinates gives only 139. Neither exceeds 140. After, the actual four-flat restriction gives at least 141.
- Complete primary coverage includes 788,035 six-flats, 2,025 frames and 963,900 relevant four-flat tests. A separate forward-echelon census covers all 3,309,747 four-flats and reconstructs frames by Weyl orbit. Exact masks and weighted counts agree.
- A separate Gram-intersection, two-plus-three clique and integer-rank implementation agrees on all 7,350 mixed five-cliques, including 3,360 independent cases.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and sixteen optimized controls pass. Python 3.13 agrees, including all four programs from the read-only Git-free export of the exact commit. Ruff, warning-as-error compilation, replay planning and all 22 publication-byte comparisons pass locally.
- Published commit: `92675b36a8e0ea41b40f0bcda2a3dd9f313abb0e`. Remote branch head matches it.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a6-weighted-cover
```

The standard Weyl-chamber theorem, inherited root-plane argument and original decoder reduction remain explicit dependencies. These are author checks with separately implemented finite algorithms, not independent human or proof-kernel review. Hosted CI is separate. No full C5, decoder-floor, supplier or new kappa claim; the selected frontier is unchanged.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research.

One isolated opt-in package. No shared-code, priority, selected-result or canonical frozen-input changes.
